data_licence.attribution: Contains data from the DoltHub repositories post-no-preference/earnings and post-no-preference/options, and from the Wikipedia List of S&P 500 companies (revision 1382178819), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International (CC BY-SA 4.0). Changes: selected, filtered and computed on by this project. The IVs and moves are computed with the rate FRED DTB3: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System (US), 3-Month Treasury Bill Secondary Market Rate, Discount Basis [DTB3], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/DTB3, 2026-10-29 (public domain). Not under CC BY-SA: the labels made from Yahoo Finance prices (security.in_universe and timing_check.gap_verdict_yf, and the share of gap contradictions built from it) fall under Yahoo's terms of service. The market-adjusted aggregates (results.parquet, tests.json, event_paths.json) are computed with FRED VIXCLS (Cboe VIX): Chicago Board Options Exchange, CBOE Volatility Index: VIX [VIXCLS], retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis, https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/VIXCLS, 2026-10-29; they fall under Cboe's terms, not CC BY-SA. No Cboe VX* data is committed.

data_sources.name: Wikipedia List of S&P 500 companies
data_sources.uses: company names, GICS sectors and CIKs (revision 1382178819)

data_sources.licence: public domain (FRED asks for a citation)
data_sources.name: FRED DTB3
data_sources.uses: the 3-month Treasury bill rate: the discount factor and the carry inside the committed IVs and moves (the rate series itself stays local)

data_sources.name: FRED VIXCLS (Cboe VIX)
data_sources.uses: the VIX close, for the market adjustment; committed: aggregates of VIX-adjusted values (the market-adjusted rows of results.parquet, tests.json and event_paths.json); the VIX series and every per-event VIX-adjusted value stay local

data_sources.name: Cboe single-stock volatility indices (VX*)
data_sources.uses: VXAPL, VXAZN, VXGOG, VXGS, VXIBM, to validate our 30-day IV (local only; not run yet)

data_sources.name: Yahoo Finance
data_sources.uses: daily prices and market caps, read with yfinance (local); committed: two labels made from them, security.in_universe and timing_check.gap_verdict_yf
